The Associate Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is responsible for supporting the coordination of budgeting, monitoring, analyzing, and forecasting the department or company’s overall financial performance. The Associate Director will play a critical role in helping to consolidate financial results and provide valuable insights to senior leadership about the department or company’s financial trajectory. - Allocation Frameworks: Assist with the development of the cost allocation management and frameworks that align with the operating model

- Systems & Processes: Provide insight into internal finance processes, including oversight of financial planning system(s) and allocations, integrity of raw financial data and granular reporting capabilities

- Communication: Communicate financial results, trends, and recommendations to leadership and other stakeholders in a clear and concise manner
